title: Choose the GlucoBar icon direction (bolder hand)
question: Bolder register: the deal put the Illuminated Initial in the lead. Two challengers beat it on both axes; take any card, or re-roll.

options.label: Illuminated Initial
options.thesis: A minium-red G in a gold-leaf chamber, its lapis vine climbing out as the day's glucose trace and ending in a Trend leaf.
options.viewport: Gold chamber upper left holding the G; the blue vine escapes right and rises into an arrowhead.
options.risk: Reads as a book or font app; the vine-as-trace is lost below 64 px, leaving just a G.

raised.raise: Ember discipline: the hot colour (minium red) marks only the entry point, never decoration.
One thing owns the frame: the initial fills the squircle rather than sitting as a badge.

options.label: 3 a.m. Bedside Clock
options.thesis: The Reading in red LED segments with ghost cells, the way a 3 a.m. low is actually met.
options.viewport: A black clock body; a recessed display reads 112 in lit segments, a lit Trend arrow bottom right.
options.case: Wins both axes: every Patient knows the night clock, and a number beside the clock is the product itself.
options.risk: Near-black plus red glow is a familiar look, and red can read as an Alert all the time.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.lineage: early one-bit Mac desktops and 32-pixel icons
options.thesis: A true 32 x 32 one-bit icon: a window on a dithered desktop, the menu bar above, the Reading inside.
options.viewport: Dithered desktop, white menu bar on top, a striped-title window holding 112 and a pixel Trend arrow.
options.case: Wins both axes: it is the Mac's own heritage, and the menu bar and Reading are literally in frame.
options.risk: Nostalgia can read as a joke or an emulator; one-bit ignores Tahoe's layered glass.

options.label: Akari Lantern
options.lineage: Noguchi-style washi and bamboo light sculptures
options.thesis: The Reading glows softly inside a paper lantern; a vermilion stamp carries the Trend.
options.viewport: A glowing lantern centred in a dim room, 112 set light inside it, a red stamp lower right.
options.case: Holds audience calm ('calm until it matters') but loses product clarity: it reads as a lamp.
options.risk: Reads as a home or lighting app; the stamp is tiny at small sizes.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: The Reading full-bleed with a rail of Action glyphs down the right.
options.viewport: 112 filling the frame, bell, phone and arrow glyphs stacked right.
options.case: Fuses poorly: reads as a social video app.
options.kept: One thing owns the whole frame.

options.label: Raku Smoke Flash
options.thesis: A soot-black vessel with crackled silver glaze, ember orange only while hot.
options.viewport: A cracked bowl with the Reading in the glaze.
options.case: Fuses poorly: craft pottery says nothing about glucose or a menu bar.
options.kept: Ember discipline: the hot colour only marks the active state.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A CGM trace threading a target band on a blue-teal gradient squircle.
canonCard.viewport: A wavy glucose line crossing a pale in-range band, ending in a dot.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every diabetes app and reads clinical.
